`getNodeParameters` no longer strips the leading `=` from `$fromAI` placeholders on fields with `noDataExpression: true`. The fix is in `src/node-helpers.ts`. `test/node-helpers.test.ts` passes, 185 of 185, including the new test for this case. The typecheck printed nothing, which I read as clean. The lint run failed on a tooling problem and checked nothing.

**Cause:** `getNodeParameters` removed the `=` prefix from every expression on a `noDataExpression` field. That turned `={{ $fromAI(...) }}` into plain text, so the placeholder was never resolved.

**Fix:** the stripping now skips any value containing `$fromAI(`. It uses a case-insensitive regex, matching the pattern in `from-ai-parse-utils.ts`. Other expressions on these fields are still stripped as before.

**Test:** I added "should keep $fromAI placeholders intact when noDataExpression is true" next to the existing `noDataExpression` tests. It failed before the fix and passes after.

**Lint:** `acdc-lint` reported "Failed to find tsgolint executable", so my change hasn't been linted.
